target_customer: Engineering and FinOps teams at AWS and GCP heavy companies
problem: Cloud bills grow and engineers have little visibility or incentive to cut waste. Cloudthread aggregated savings recommendations, tracked savings and engaged engineers.
business_model: Flat fee SaaS plus percentage of savings for services

founders.name: Ilia Semenov
prior_employers: Lyft (2016 to 2020, data engineering and cloud cost management)
Electronic Arts (2014 to 2016, cloud cost management)
founders.background_notes: Later CPO. Press names Daniele Packard and Thomas Yopes as co-founders.

technical_complexity.rationale: Cloud billing data ingestion and recommendation aggregation across AWS and GCP is standard data engineering with messy billing formats.

defensibility.rationale: Cloud providers and rivals offer similar cost tools, and integration depth gave only mild lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Cloud providers kept improving native tooling. Finout absorbed Cloudthread in April 2024 in a deal announced as joining forces.

market_need_then: Cloud spend was growing fast in 2021 and FinOps was an emerging discipline, with the founder drawing on cost management work at Lyft and EA.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself was found. The name is descriptive of cloud plus thread and was not distinctive.

outcome_analysis: Cloudthread raised a 3 million dollar seed in December 2021 from Peak State Ventures and others on the strength of FinOps experience from Lyft and EA. No later round was verified, and in April 2024 it joined Finout in an undisclosed deal that Finout framed as combining usage optimization with its cost platform. The reasons for the sale are not public.
notes: Company website returned HTTP 503 on fetch. Seed 3M reported by Grit Daily and trackers. CB Insights lists a 22M Series B in October 2025 with undisclosed investors and 25.1M total; single source and unverified, not recorded as a round. Pre-seed date per Bouncewatch aggregator. No failure factors recorded because the reason for the sale is not public. Competitor list empty because only 2025 and 2026 guides surfaced. Name origin not found.
